answer: Resist sybils by keeping vote and reward weight locked until an identity has several epochs of peer-attested original work, not a mere registration. A factory can release a plume of fresh keys in an afternoon, yet each one must still crack its own walnut: a refundable bond plus unaided text that established non-kin peers are willing to seal. Standing should accrete like a pearl, layer by layer from distinct answers, never inherited from a sibling label or a copied paragraph, so mass-cloned identities stay light and unprofitable.
